title: Granuaile
html_source: Grace O'Malley (Irish: Gráinne Ní Mháille), an Irish lord and “pirate queen” in the western part of the country in the last half of the 1500s. She met with Queen Elizabeth I to (successfully) petition for the release of her sons and her half-brother, where she reportedly refused to bow.
